title: Laparoscopic Hernia Defect Obliteration With ProFlor-E
brief_summary: This feasibility study highlights the features of the 3D dynamic responsive prosthesis ProFlor-E® for fixation free obliteration of inguinal hernia defect
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients with recurrent inguinal hernia already repaired with open approach or suffering by bilateral inguinal hernias

Exclusion Criteria:

* ASA \>4 patients
